name: Romania

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 230,080 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 19,020,271. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 69,900 active; CIA Factbook 2025 ~70,000; Romanian Armed Forces article: ~90,000 active and 55,000 reserves (2025, Euronews) (high). Mid ~75,000.

trainedReserves.note: IISS as quoted and Romanian Armed Forces article: 55,000 reserves.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 75,000 minus infantry P roles (16,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Romania 1941-44 (~1.2 million mobilized from ~16 million, ~7.5%) for a state that ended conscription in 2007 but legislated voluntary service in 2025.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 621,909,804,034 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 19,020,271 = 32,697. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 776,901,691,485 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 621,909,804,034 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.28% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 2.17% in 2024, 1.86% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 25.3% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 9,211,812 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 6.095% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 112,295. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Moreni plant assembles Piranha V; Lynx deal planned.

roadKm.note: As quoted: 86,847 km of which 65,315 paved (2026 row).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 10,769 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 0 large + 2 medium (Constanta is the largest Black Sea port).

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Not in the quoted UNCTAD table; CIA Factbook lists 127 Romanian-flag vessels (2023), mostly small. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_merchant_navy_capacity_by_country)

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: Carpathian arc, familiar terrain, population support.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:ROU. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Romanian Land Forces equipment list, active Romanian military aircraft list and naval forces article; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Personnel figures disagree (70,000-90,000).
